summary: The bounded provider-recovery executor can safely reacquire an independently verified durable retry/replay lease, but the sealed runtime has no safe internal hand-off that gives a normal provider adapter worker the retained continuation request after that reacquisition. Public detail deliberately exposes only a digest, and the recovery HTTP response correctly omits the continuation payload.
root_cause: Authority and execution are intentionally separated, but the current runtime stops one step too early: executePermit consumes the one-shot grant and acquires the durable provider job using the recovery worker identity, while the normal provider adapter has no internal capability-bound continuation channel under that acquired lease. Exposing nextRequest in the browser/admin recovery response would break the trust boundary, so the gap cannot be fixed by returning raw continuation state.
unsafe_fixes_forbidden: Do not expose raw nextRequest through the browser/admin recovery endpoint.
Do not read private provider-job SQLite columns from browser-facing or generic application code.
Do not weaken lease ownership to let arbitrary workers reacquire an active run.
Do not grant the recovery executor provider-network or workforce-business-mutation authority.
Do not let an LLM select, modify or execute provider continuation payloads.
proposed_design: Introduce an internal-only provider recovery hand-off capability. After the bounded executor successfully acquires the verified retry/replay lease, it should create a short-lived one-shot hand-off bound to tenant, provider run, lease owner, evidence digest, verification digest, safety decision and action grant. A server-internal provider worker/orchestrator can consume that hand-off to obtain the retained continuation request and continue via the normal sealed adapter contract. The HTTP recovery endpoint must continue returning only the existing sanitised execution result.
proof_required_before_merge: Customer/provider text cannot create or alter a hand-off.
Wrong tenant, wrong run, wrong worker, expired token and replay are denied.
State change after verification invalidates the hand-off.
Raw continuation never appears in API/browser responses or audit detail.
Normal adapter resumes from the committed checkpoint rather than page one.
Identical page replay is deduplicated and changed payload under the same idempotency key is denied.
Provider completion reconciles source = staged + held and held = 0 before a green completion claim.
Held-record completion remains review-only and receives no autonomous runbook.
No payroll write, direct LLM execution, cross-tenant action or unknown repair authority is introduced.
next_action: Implement and prove the internal hand-off on a derived staging candidate from canonical source, preserving full provenance and exact-runtime gates; do not patch the sealed 0.6.76 artifact in place.
